key_insight: EchoTab learns measurement-specific tokens from multi-view echocardiography, using tabular reconstruction to create clinically meaningful intermediate representations before diagnosis.
clinical_relevance: By grounding representations in standard echocardiographic measurements, the approach can improve diagnostic classification while aligning with how clinicians interpret echo studies.
method: Measurement tokens each attend to the echo views relevant to a specific cardiac measurement.
Tokens are trained with tabular reconstruction to predict measurement values.
The resulting factorized representation is then used for downstream diagnosis.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on two datasets showing improved diagnosis classification and attention patterns that match established measurement-view relationships.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the availability and quality of measurement labels, and real-world integration will need validation across broader echo workflows and sites.
paper_title: EchoTab: Learning Measurement-Grounded Representations for Echocardiographic Diagnosis through Tabular Reconstruction
